payload.excerpt_zh: 在2025年9月26日至10月3日于佐治亚州佩里市Guardian Centers举行的系统竞赛中，各团队在模拟C-130飞机坠毁和夜间伏击场景的场地上进行导航，这些场景因烟雾、黑暗和视觉障碍而变得复杂。
payload.normalized_claim: 系统竞赛于2025年9月26日至10月3日在佐治亚州佩里市Guardian Centers举行。
payload.title: DART and MSAI triumph at DARPA Triage Challenge

payload.excerpt_original: Coordinated Robotics earned the top prize of $300,000, demonstrating robotic platforms that successfully detected vital signs and identified injury patterns despite impaired visibility and environmental complexity.
payload.excerpt_zh: Coordinated Robotics赢得了30万美元的最高奖金，展示了在能见度受损和环境复杂的情况下成功检测生命体征并识别损伤模式的机器人平台。
payload.normalized_claim: 据DARPA竞赛环境中的官方披露结果，Coordinated Robotics展示了能够检测生命体征和识别损伤模式的机器人平台。
payload.title: DART and MSAI triumph at DARPA Triage Challenge

payload.excerpt_original: In the Data Competition, teams tackled DARPA-provided datasets of de-identified physiological data from trauma patients.
payload.excerpt_zh: 在数据竞赛中，各团队处理了DARPA提供的来自创伤患者的去标识化生理数据集。
payload.normalized_claim: 数据竞赛中团队使用了DARPA提供的去标识化创伤患者生理数据。
payload.title: DART and MSAI triumph at DARPA Triage Challenge

payload.excerpt_original: The DARPA Triage Challenge is strengthened by the contributions of government and industry partners, including the Naval Information Warfare Center, the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory, the US Army Institute of Surgical Research, the University of Maryland, Baltimore, and the University of Pittsburgh, who collectively provide data, independent verification and validation, and technical expertise to ensure rigorous evaluation of triage solutions.
payload.excerpt_zh: DARPA分诊挑战赛因政府和行业合作伙伴的贡献而得到加强，包括海军信息战中心、约翰霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室、美国陆军外科研究所、马里兰大学巴尔的摩分校和匹兹堡大学，他们共同提供数据、独立验证和确认以及技术专长，以确保对分诊解决方案进行严格评估。
payload.normalized_claim: 多个政府和行业合作伙伴为DARPA分诊挑战赛提供数据、独立验证和技术专长。

payload.excerpt_original: the US Army Futures Command set out a roadmap in 2022 on how it plans to have AI assist with decision-making in military medicine
payload.excerpt_zh: 美国陆军未来司令部于2022年制定了一份路线图，计划让AI辅助军事医学决策。
payload.normalized_claim: 美国陆军未来司令部计划让AI辅助军事医学决策。

payload.excerpt_original: the 15-year dataset in the US Joint Trauma System Department of Defense Trauma Registry (DoDTR) contains only 0.017 Gigabytes of data, despite including over 140,000 patient records
